readOnlyHint.justification: Searches MailMyPDF's bounded workflow catalog and does not create, update, delete, enqueue, or send anything.

destructiveHint.justification: Catalog search cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, send, pay, or trigger any irreversible action.

openWorldHint.justification: Search is limited to MailMyPDF's own canonical workflow catalog and does not access the public internet or arbitrary external entities.

readOnlyHint.justification: Retrieves metadata for one canonical MailMyPDF workflow without changing server state.

destructiveHint.justification: Workflow metadata lookup has no destructive or irreversible side effect.

openWorldHint.justification: Reads only MailMyPDF's bounded internal workflow catalog.

readOnlyHint.justification: Reads the identity of the already-authenticated MailMyPDF account and does not modify it.

destructiveHint.justification: Profile lookup cannot modify account data or perform any irreversible action.

openWorldHint.justification: Access is limited to the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF account.

readOnlyHint.justification: Creates persistent owner-scoped workflow matter state in MailMyPDF.

destructiveHint.justification: Creating an empty matter does not delete or overwrite existing data, send anything, charge anything, or trigger irreversible fulfillment.

openWorldHint.justification: The write is confined to the authenticated user's MailMyPDF workspace.

readOnlyHint.justification: Retrieves an owner-scoped matter snapshot and attached-document metadata without modifying it.

destructiveHint.justification: Matter retrieval cannot delete, overwrite, send, charge, or trigger an irreversible action.

openWorldHint.justification: Reads only the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF matter state.

readOnlyHint.justification: Reads MailMyPDF's recorded payment, fulfillment, tracking, and delivery state without polling or mutating the provider.

destructiveHint.justification: Status lookup cannot alter an order, payment, mailing, or provider state.

openWorldHint.justification: Reads only bounded MailMyPDF account/order records and does not query arbitrary internet resources.

readOnlyHint.justification: Reads the security/readiness state of a document already attached to the authenticated user's matter.

destructiveHint.justification: Readiness lookup cannot change, delete, release, or process the stored document.

openWorldHint.justification: Reads only bounded MailMyPDF matter/document metadata.

readOnlyHint.justification: Downloads a user-authorized attachment, records processing consent, stores it in MailMyPDF quarantine, and attaches it to a matter.

destructiveHint.justification: The tool adds quarantined data but does not delete or overwrite user data, approve a packet, charge a payment method, or submit mail.

openWorldHint.justification: The tool fetches a user-provided public HTTPS attachment URL, with SSRF, redirect, type, and size protections before MailMyPDF intake.

readOnlyHint.justification: Persists a new version of structured workflow facts for an owner-scoped MailMyPDF matter.

destructiveHint.justification: Inputs are versioned rather than destructively overwriting prior records, and the tool does not send, charge, or fulfill anything.

openWorldHint.justification: The write is confined to the authenticated user's MailMyPDF matter.

readOnlyHint.justification: Runs workflow analysis and persists the resulting analysis record for the matter.

destructiveHint.justification: Analysis adds derived matter state but does not delete or overwrite source documents, approve a packet, charge, or mail.

openWorldHint.justification: Analysis can call the configured external AI model service using the clean, workflow-scoped document context.

readOnlyHint.justification: Invokes the configured drafting model and produces workflow draft state for the matter.

destructiveHint.justification: Draft generation does not delete source data, approve a packet, charge a payment method, or submit mail; drafts remain reviewable and replaceable.

openWorldHint.justification: Draft generation can call the configured external AI model service.

readOnlyHint.justification: Persists the exact user-reviewed draft text as a new current draft version.

destructiveHint.justification: Drafts are versioned and saving text does not itself approve, charge, or mail anything.

openWorldHint.justification: The write is confined to the authenticated user's MailMyPDF matter and does not contact open-ended external entities.

readOnlyHint.justification: Builds the packet preview and persists measured page-count metadata used by the existing packet workflow, so it is not strictly read-only.

destructiveHint.justification: Preview does not approve the packet, charge the user, delete data, or submit mail; it only calculates/reconciles review metadata.

openWorldHint.justification: Packet construction and pricing operate on the bounded MailMyPDF matter, stored documents, and internal pricing rules.

readOnlyHint.justification: Persists an explicit approval record bound to the exact packet hash, price, recipient fingerprint, recipient, and mail class.

destructiveHint.justification: Approval alone does not charge a payment method or submit mail, and a changed packet/recipient requires a new approval.

openWorldHint.justification: Approval is recorded only inside the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF matter.

readOnlyHint.justification: Creates or reuses MailMyPDF order state and a Stripe-hosted checkout session for an already-approved packet.

destructiveHint.justification: The tool does not collect card data, complete payment, or submit mail; the user must separately complete Stripe-hosted checkout.

openWorldHint.justification: Checkout preparation communicates with Stripe, an external payment service, to create/reuse the hosted checkout session.
